motivation: A 52-observation objective profile at unchanged source measured about 0.044 seconds per evaluation; 3928/4753 sampled stacks include numerical_snapshot and 3544 include star_point_valid. Repeated immutable Born payload hashing is a measured hotspot, not a changed physical approximation.
immutable_domain: JetBornKinematics contains only Float64 fields. JetBornTerm contains Int, Symbol and Float64 fields. JetBornPlan contains that immutable kinematics object, Tuple{Vararg{Int}}, Symbol and Tuple{Vararg{JetBornTerm}}; its constructor copies supplied flavor/term collections into tuples. These values have no mutable array/dictionary leaves through supported Julia operations.
cache: An inner StarPointPlan constructor must derive the immutable Born payload fingerprint from its actual owned tuple. No caller-supplied digest or trusted Boolean is accepted. The point's signature binds that fingerprint and every previously checked mutable field. Its source/schema change invalidates older point/cache receipts.
unchanged_mutation_checks: Every normal prediction continues to validate all mutable matrices, vectors, operator/sample rows, fragmentation settings and provenance. No general validation bypass, mutable-data memoization, task-local guard suppression or skipped end-of-job source check is introduced.
unchanged_physics: No prediction arithmetic, signs, normalization/mass/z factors, coupling/evolution, likelihood, cuts, overlap or accepted dataset is changed. Keep the solver/convolution/Fortran sources and external/ unchanged.

validation.baseline: Before cache implementation, capture six fixed parameter cases on the 52-observation model: truth, two frozen starts, the finite 4000-evaluation candidate, simultaneous global sign flip and the closed-Nh/zero-transversity-shape boundary. Store prediction/objective values and interior gradients/HVPs with source/lock/contract bindings.
validation.matching_targets: Inherit parent algebra/prediction 1e-11 and gradient/HVP 1e-7 scaled targets with 1e-8 floor, without alteration. Record bitwise agreement separately; do not require a different machine's BLAS reduction to have identical bits.
validation.immutable_constructor_checks: Check the cached payload against independent complete enumeration, show that normal supported mutation is unavailable, reject supplied fake cache fields, and verify constructor ownership of mutable input collections.
validation.mutable_controls: Retain and run all existing STAR/point/bin/cache mutation tests; independently mutate every still-mutable StarPointPlan data family and provenance and require rejection.
validation.timing: Repeat the same complete objective measurement and record the difference as informational only, not a physical G2PERF certificate.
validation.fitting: Preserve the initial 4000-evaluation INCOMPLETE report. Continue the already frozen 20000/80000 resource ladder with unchanged closure thresholds and explicit termination handling.

limitations: An immutable-source fingerprint is an integrity/cache property, not independent physics validation
Original paper-center failures, covariance/acceptance/overlap, author-code and production admission limitations persist
No inference coverage or physical fitting throughput claim is introduced
